goal: Run the type checker in strict mode with no emit and confirm zero errors in src/checks.js, confirm no new type errors in any other file under src/ against the pre-change baseline, and run the existing test suite to confirm every existing test still passes.

steps.action: Read src/checks.js — a plain read first, then recall/get each symbol (secs, exec, http, tcp, ssl, disk, newestMatch, fileAge, service, command, CHECKS) — and grep tsconfig.json, package.json, src/run.js and test/pulselog.test.js for the compiler flags and for every call site of CHECKS and its helpers. Then edit src/checks.js so it is clean under the type checker in strict mode with no emit: add or correct JSDoc on every parameter, return value, catch binding and internal helper, describe the check config objects and the {ok, reason, detail} result shape with @typedef, and narrow caught errors from unknown before reading properties off them. Keep every runtime behaviour, exported name and call signature exactly as today; do not edit files outside src/checks.js. The check output handed back to you names the remaining errors — fix them in src/checks.js and continue until that file is clean.

This is the final step and it owns the whole goal: src/checks.js must come back with zero errors from the type checker in strict mode with no emit, no other file under src/ may show a new error against the pre-change baseline, and the existing test suite must stay green. Read the check output you are handed, then read and fix whichever file under src/ it names — mainly src/checks.js, using recall/get on exec, http, tcp, ssl, disk, newestMatch, fileAge, service, command and CHECKS, with grep for their call sites in src/run.js and test/pulselog.test.js. Prefer JSDoc types, @typedef shapes and local narrowing over runtime edits; keep exported names, signatures and behaviour unchanged; never remove or weaken a test, and never silence an error with @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error or a looser annotation. Work in a loop: diagnose from the handed-back output, edit the files it reports, and keep going until src/checks.js is clean, other files under src/ are not worse, and every existing test still passes.
